question: Should LiteLLM interactive onboarding collect a base URL and discover models from that URL, or should remote LiteLLM proxies stay routed through Custom Provider and non-interactive --custom-base-url setup?
rationale: Current code supports remote proxy configuration through other paths, but adding a LiteLLM-specific prompt changes the provider setup contract and may deserve a generic provider metadata seam instead of a one-off wizard branch.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have the LiteLLM-owned onboarding path ask for the proxy URL before model discovery so the documented LiteLLM auth choice works for remote proxies.

options.title: Document Custom Provider Route
options.body: Keep LiteLLM's interactive auth path localhost-oriented and make the wizard/docs clearly route remote proxies through Custom Provider or non-interactive --custom-base-url.

options.title: Create Generic Provider Setup Seam
options.body: Add provider metadata for optional base-URL collection and migrate LiteLLM through that shared setup contract.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have the LiteLLM-owned onboarding path ask for the proxy URL before model discovery so the documented LiteLLM auth choice works for remote proxies.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history points to steipete for LiteLLM pluginization and provider catalog setup work.
